body.name: Meridian Travel Adapter Pro
body.description: The Meridian Travel Adapter Pro. A dependable power pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Travel Adapter, Travel pouch, Warranty card, Quick-start guide, USB-C to USB-C cable

reviews.author: Yusuf R.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Meridian seem to have got this one right. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Manish K.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Matches the listing description exactly. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Lakshmi K.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Meridian seem to have got this one right. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Rhea N.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Meridian seem to have got this one right. No regrets.

reviews.author: Priya C.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Packaging was tidy and nothing was missing. No regrets.
